target.title: fix: strip conda env marker from host tool runs
target.body:
Closes #99424

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw-managed host subprocesses could inherit Conda's active/default environment selectors from the parent process. Stripping only `CONDA_PREFIX` is insufficient: current Conda source falls back to `CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV` when resolving `Context.default_prefix` without an active prefix.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared host-exec security policy already strips `VIRTUAL_ENV`. This change adds both Conda selectors to the same blocked-override-only bucket, which also makes them blocked inherited keys:

- `CONDA_PREFIX`
- `CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV`

The policy remains narrow. It does not add a broad `CONDA_` prefix rule or change `PATH` handling. The generated macOS policy mirror and reported baseline are regenerated from the same canonical policy.

The `CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV` half was converged from closed competing PR #99440 after direct review of [Conda's current default-prefix resolution](https://github.com/conda/conda/blob/56a19243422cb08f3791f901048a4e0d089e6472/conda/base/context.py#L812-L828).

## User Impact

Launching OpenClaw from an activated Conda shell no longer passes either Conda target selector into managed host subprocesses. Unrelated inherited environment behavior remains unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: current main and shipped v2026.6.11 block `VIRTUAL_ENV` but neither Conda selector.
- Contributor live proof: a real Conda-activated Windows parent had `CONDA_PREFIX` set; an OpenClaw-sanitized child received no prefix, rejected a requested prefix override, and exited 0.
- Maintainer child-process proof on the improved head:

  ```json
  {"rejected":["CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV","CONDA_PREFIX"],"child":{"CONDA_PREFIX":null,"CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV":null,"OPENCLAW_CLI":"1"},"status":0}
  ```

- Focused tests:

  ```text
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/host-env-security.test.ts src/infra/host-env-security.reported-baseline.test.ts src/infra/host-env-security.policy-parity.test.ts
  Test Files  3 passed (3)
  Tests       42 passed (42)

  node scripts/generate-host-env-security-policy-swift.mjs --check
  OK apps/macos/Sources/OpenClaw/HostEnvSecurityPolicy.generated.swift
  ```

- Fresh autoreview after the two-selector improvement: no accepted/actionable findings.

What was not tested: the maintainer machine has no local Conda installation. The contributor proof covers a real Conda parent; the maintainer proof covers the improved two-selector sanitizer and real child-process boundary.
